about: Task eval set (RAMAN-TASK R11). 20 requests a user could type, six with a cadence. `needs` lists the tools a correct plan would bind; `accept` holds lowercase substrings matched against the slug and name of an item. They were written on 2026-11-10 before the first run and are not tuned to its output. `{{PLANTED_KEY}}` is replaced at run time by a key-shaped test string that must never appear in any output. Run: npm run eval:tasks (no model: catalog lookup + cadence rule) or npm run eval:tasks -- --llm (full runs with the EVAL_* key).
